bullets: The outcome. Own the Resident Onboarding Lift roadmap and the numbers it moves: AppFolio door enablement, enrollment rate, and resident adoption. You set the targets, you report…
AppFolio fluency. Become the person at Second Nature who best understands how resident onboarding actually works inside AppFolio: lease templates, signing order, counter-signing…
Execution. Write requirements that are clear, complete, and fast to build against. Align engineering, marketing, and support so launches land with customers instead of just…
The craft. You won't manage anyone, but you will set the standard. Model the discovery-through-iteration practices the rest of the product org learns from.
Attach rates across the core portfolio, with the mechanisms understood well enough to repeat as product lines expand
The share of new revenue carried by newer product lines, broadening the portfolio beyond its current base
Retention and new logo acquisition, with clear attribution to the work that drove them
Unit economics across the portfolio, improved without trading away growth
A roadmap that is a rationalized allocation of investment against business outcomes, resourced to execute and delivered against
